SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DOC_NAME , TARGET AS BUYER , KEY_1 AS QUOTATION_NO , KEY_2 AS QUOTATION_SEQ , KEY_3 AS REVISION , KEY_4 AS KEP_SEQ FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'SYGP_RJT' AND KEY_9 = 'N' UNION SELECT 'RQ' AS DOC_NAME , BUYER , QUOTATION_NO , QUOTATION_SEQ , TO_CHAR(REVISION) AS REVISION , '1' AS KEP_SEQ FROM KEPRQDT WHERE BUYER IN (SELECT TEXT4 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = 'KRSYSE0001' AND TYPE = 'PLNT') AND QUOTATION_NO NOT LIKE 'RE%' AND ( (RECV_FLAG = 'CM' AND ATOB_SEND_FLAG = 'Y') or (QUOTATION_NO NOT LIKE 'RE%' AND RECV_FLAG = 'GD')) AND SND_CHK IN ('N','T')
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT PLANT , BUYER_ITEM_NO , 0 AS UNIT_PRICE , MAKER_NAME , ORIGIN_NAME , NULL AS ITEM_NO , REQ_USER_NAME , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS ATOB_DATE , SUBSTRB(DESCRIPTION,1,200) AS DESCRIPTION , SUBSTRB(SPECIFICATION,1,500) AS SPECIFICATION , UNIT_MEASURE , ADD_DATE||ADD_TIME AS BTOA_DATE , 'D' AS REJECT_STAT , '중복' AS REJECT_DESC , ' ' AS QUOTATION_NO , ' ' AS QUOTATION_SEQ , f_split(REF_IF_NO,'^',1) AS SY_SEQ , f_split(REF_IF_NO,'^',2) AS REG_ID , f_split(REF_IF_NO,'^',3) AS CONT_ID , f_split(REF_IF_NO,'^',4) AS SEQ , ' ' as SUB_SUPP_NM , 0 as MIN_ORDER_QTY FROM IF_REDT_UC WHERE BUYER = 'SYGP' AND KEP_SEQ= $G_RS.KEP_SEQ$ UNION ALL SELECT nvl(trim(RQDT.PLANT),' ') AS PLANT , RQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , QTDT.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE , SUBSTRB(RQDT.MAKER_NAME,1,30) AS MAKER_NAME , RQDT.ORIGIN_NAME , RQDT.CMS_CATLG_ID AS ITEM_NO , RQDT.BTOA_USER_NAME , RQDT.ATOB_DATE , SUBSTRB(RQDT.DESCRIPTION,1,200) AS DESCRIPTION , SUBSTRB(RQDT.SPECIFICATION,1,500) AS SPECIFICATION , RQDT.UNIT_MEASURE , RQDT.BTOA_DATE||BTOA_TIME AS BTOA_DATE , DECODE(RQDT.RECV_FLAG,'CM','A','PC','A','CC','A','GD','K','X') AS REJECT_STAT , RQDT.CANCEL_REMARK AS REJECT_DESC , RQDT.QUOTATION_NO , RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ , f_split(RQDT.REF_NO,'^',1) AS SY_SEQ , f_split(RQDT.REF_NO,'^',2) AS REQ_ID , f_split(RQDT.REF_NO,'^',3) AS CONT_ID , f_split(RQDT.REF_NO,'^',4) AS SEQ , (select com_name_loc from icomcmpy where com_code = qtdt.agent) AS SUB_SUPP_NM , QTDT.MIN_ORDER_QTY AS MIN_ORDER_QTY FROM KEPRQDT RQDT, KEPQTDT QTDT WHERE RQDT.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND RQDT.QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ= '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND RQDT.REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$' AND RQDT.BUYER = QTDT.BUYER(+) AND RQDT.QUOTATION_NO = QTDT.QUOTATION_NO(+) AND RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ= QTDT.QUOTATION_SEQ(+) AND RQDT.REVISION = QTDT.REVISION(+) AND QTDT.STATUS(+) = 'C' AND QTDT.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG(+) = 'Y'
DECLARE BEGIN IF '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' = 'SYGP_RJT' THEN UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'Y' , KEY_8 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'SYGP_RJT' AND TARGET = 'SYGP' AND KEY_4 = '$G_RS.KEP_SEQ$'; ELSE UPDATE KEPRQDT SET SND_CHK = 'Y' , SND_DATM= SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND QUOTATION_SEQ= '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$'; END IF; END;
